text:
maria: Hey team — quick heads up, I need to swap my Sat morning oncall block (8:00–12:00 PST) due to travel. Can anyone pick up or split it? I can cover an overlap 11–12 if that helps.
jamal: I can do 9–11 PST if that helps, @maria. Not ideal for full 8–12. :thumbsup:
zhen: I can take 8–12 if you do a 10m handoff before you go. Have to step out around 13:00 my time but Saturday morning is fine.
anya: Is there any scheduled work we should be aware of during that window? I have a brief meeting but can be on standby.
oncall-bot: Reminder: infra/maintenance -> db-compaction job scheduled Sat 10:15 PST. Expected IO spike ~30m. (runbook: https://confluence.redwood/ops/db-compaction)
maria: Thanks — yes, db-compaction at 10:15 is the main risk. Also a small canary rollout for search-rerank is scheduled later that evening (not during your window) but rollout-prep artifacts land earlier.
maria: Handoff notes if @zhen picks up: 1) Watch compaction job from 10:10–10:50; check compactor pod logs and PG replicas lag. 2) Partner embedding job (partner-x) sometimes spikes memory — check k8s HPA and restart policy. 3) Escalations -> pager: oncall escalation channel, then call Jamal if DB issues.
maria: Quick commands I run for checks: ```kubectl -n infra logs deploy/compactor -f --since=10m``` ```psql -c "select now(),pg_stat_replication.* from pg_stat_replication;" -h prod-db-01```
zhen: Got it. I'll own 8–12. I'll ping here at 08:00 with a short thumbs-up and then again at 10:10 to confirm compaction start.
jamal: If compaction causes tail latency >200ms, we have the temporary throttling flag: `POST /admin/flags` body `{ "search_throttle": true }` — follow runbook.
anya: Noted. Any special logs/alerts to mute during compaction to avoid alert fatigue?
zhen: We should suppress the transient high-IO alert on storage-io-ops for 10:10–10:50 — will open a mute with the alerting UI and drop the link here.
maria: Thanks @zhen. Also, if you see partner-x job memory >85% for >5m, please bump the job to a smaller batch (runbook snippet in confluence).
jamal: I'll be reachable on my phone in case you need a DB handoff. :phone:
zhen: Opened alert mute: https://alerts.redwood/mutes/12345 (expires 11:00 PST). Leaving a short note in the mute: "planned compaction window".
maria: Perfect. Leaving quick checklist for when I sign out: - confirm latest canary tag not pushed to prod - send this thread to oncall mailing list - attach short dump of recent replica lag.
anya: Thanks for catching that. @zhen can you paste the compactor pod name once it's up so I can tail if needed?
zhen: Sure — compactor pod name usually `compactor-xyz-<rand>`. I'll paste exact name at 10:10.
maria: Awesome. Really appreciate the coverage. If anything weird happens before I leave (deploys, alerts), I'll post here. Otherwise I'll :party: before I go.
jamal: Sweet, enjoy the travel! :wave:
zhen: On it. See you folks.
oncall-bot: Note: oncall rotation metadata: owner set to zhen for 1982501234–1982505634.
